title: Trilogy Metals Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Trilogy Metals Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing that the company, through its joint venture Ambler Metals LLC (50% owned with South32 Limited), has commenced the permitting process for the Arctic Project within the Upper Kobuk Mineral Projects in northwestern Alaska's Ambler Mining District. The filing also references plans for the 2026 field season and results of an independent economic impact study.
key_points: Trilogy Metals is a British Columbia incorporated company ( ticker TMQ on NYSE American and Toronto Stock Exchange)
The company issued a press release on April 21, 2026 (Exhibit 99.1) announcing commencement of permitting for the Arctic Project
The Arctic Project is part of the Upper Kobuk Mineral Projects located in northwestern Alaska's Ambler Mining District
Ambler Metals LLC is the joint venture entity (50/50 with South32 Limited)
The filing references an independent economic impact study results
